title: Fall from cliff.
html_source:
Horatio fears that the ghost will tempt Hamlet to fall from the “dreadful summit of the cliff” (Hamlet, Act 1, Scene 4, line 78 in the Folger).

Stephen reflects on the same passage from Hamlet, e.g. in Chapter 3—Proteus: “If I fell over a cliff that beetles o'er his base” (pg. 37).
